findings.title: Evidence index does not match the layout the verifier expects
findings.message: The index lists the archive members, but the committed verifier reads its inputs from a 'prepared' directory (Q=X/'prepared') and uses absolute local paths such as /Users/dshills/.... The committed copy cannot be run from the repo, so the 'Explicit mappings verify the committed copies' claim cannot be reproduced independently. The index also records no mapping from archive layout to the 'prepared' layout (for example capture/native -> prepared/native).
findings.suggestion: Add a layout mapping to the index, or make the verifier take root and repo paths as arguments instead of hard-coded local paths, and document how to run it.
